                            <div class="col-12 single-component">
                <div class="text__component">
    <h2>Quarterly Review</h2><p>The BIS Quarterly Review examines developments in international banking and financial markets. In March, September and December, it comprises a review of market developments over the past quarter, and articles that analyse topical economic and financial issues. The June edition will be published only when circumstances warrant. The June edition does not cover market developments given its proximity to the BIS Annual Economic Report.</p><p class="alert alert-light alert-secondary">The views expressed in the Quarterly Reviews do not necessarily reflect the views of the BIS member central banks.</p>
</div>

            </div>
                    </div>
